responsibility: Declares the top-level front-end code-generation coordinator for gm2. Its two entry points either drive whole-program compilation from optimized quadruples into GCC trees or generate code for a single scope block, encapsulating the stage boundary between semantic/quadruple passes and final GCC tree emission.
same_name_distinction: This `.def` file is the narrow interface for the M2Code pair: it only exports the two top-level code-generation entry points `Code` and `CodeBlock`, whereas `M2Code.mod` contains the optimization and GCC-tree emission pipeline they drive.
